input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show eight document types arranged in a neat 2-row by 4-column grid of identical rounded-square tiles with even gutters between them and nothing drawn in the gutters. All eight tiles have the identical pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted, selected or darker tile, one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds of the tile, and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so that every label fits comfortably inside its tile with clear empty padding on the left and right. The icons contain no lettering at all, only abstract lines and blocks. Row 1, tile 1: a paper invoice with a yellow stamp; label exactly 'Invoices'. Tile 2: an order document with a small cart; label exactly 'Purchase Orders'. Tile 3: a statement page with a bank building icon; label exactly 'Bank Statements'. Tile 4: a passport and an ID card; label exactly 'KYC Packs'. Row 2, tile 5: a claim form with a shield and check mark; label exactly 'Insurance Claims'. Tile 6: a contract page with a signature line and a pen; label exactly 'Contracts'. Tile 7: a shipping container with a document; label exactly 'Customs Papers'. Tile 8: a clipboard form with a person icon; label exactly 'HR & Intake Forms'. A single small yellow spark sits near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no connecting lines, no arrows, no dotted paths anywhere. The only text in the image is the eight tile labels, all bold and perfectly spelled.
